Title: Vihaan's Day

Cast

1. Vihaan - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Meera - 12 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Sunita - 34 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Savitri - 69 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Sunita and Meera stand near him.]

Sunita: "What lovely weather!"

[Vihaan opens his umbrella.]

Vihaan: "That's easy."

[Vihaan puts on his raincoat.]

Meera (excited): "Vihaan, are you okay?"

[The rain stops.]

Vihaan: "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Meera: "So, here we are!"

[Vihaan lights a diya.]

Vihaan (laughing): "Hmm, I see."

[Vihaan paints a picture.]

Meera (excited): "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 3: The park - Day

[Vihaan stands in the park. Meera and Sunita stand near him.]

Vihaan: "Let's begin."

[Vihaan throws the ball to Mother.]

Vihaan: "Meera, look at this."

[Vihaan plays cricket in the park.]

Vihaan: "Meera, listen!"

[Vihaan swings on the swing.]

Vihaan: "Yes, of course."

[Vihaan goes down the slide.]

Vihaan (laughing): "I knew it!"

[Meera skips rope.]

Meera: "I really enjoyed today."
